name: silt-stops
displayName: klatt1980-en with stops from Kokoro measurements
source: Burst centroids measured from Kokoro v1.0 (am_onyx/echo/adam/michael, word-initial stops, 4 words each): T 5.6 kHz, D 4.4 kHz, K 3.0 kHz, G 2.0 kHz, P/B < 1 kHz. B/D/G voicing lowered so the burst isn't a nasal hum. T/D burst kept below the measured centroid and quieter: at full level a 25 ms burst reads as 'st'.
